author: Bormey
review: Checked against the dated crops and NASA source interpretation by Sabik with help from OpenAI Codex, 2026-11-15. Wording preserved.

descriptions.dhaka-rain-2025: Here’s Dhaka (Bangladesh), at the centre of NASA’s map from 15 July 2025. Brown shows drier conditions than usual; green and turquoise show wetter ones. Recent rainfall differences build up and fade over about three months.
descriptions.sylhet-rain-2025: Here’s Sylhet (Bangladesh) at the centre of NASA’s map from 15 July 2025. Brown near the centre shows drier conditions than usual; green and turquoise show wetter areas. Recent rainfall differences build up and fade over about three months.
descriptions.tonle-sap-rain-2025: Here’s Tonle Sap (Cambodia) on NASA’s map from 15 July 2025. Grey background shows through near the centre, indicating rainfall close to usual; green and turquoise show wetter areas. Recent rainfall differences build up and fade over about three months.
descriptions.hue-rain-2025: Here’s Huế (Vietnam) at the centre of NASA’s map from 15 July 2025. Green near the centre shows wetter conditions than usual; brown shows drier areas. Recent rainfall differences build up and fade over about three months.
